TileStructure.Forest.tree_projection_est.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$, and $F, G \subseteq X$. Assume given a `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` structure (the data common to chapters 2-7); through its `KernelProofData` component it makes $X$ a doubling metric measure space with constant $2^a$, and we write $\mathrm{volume}$ for the resulting measure on $X$. Let $Q := $ `ProofData.Q`, the simple function from $X$ to the type $\Theta(X)$ of functions supplied by this data. Assume also a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)`, where $\mathrm{defaultD}(a) = 2^{𝕔 a^2}$ (with $𝕔 \in \mathbb{N}$ the fixed blueprint constant, equal to $100$), $\mathrm{defaultκ}(a) = 2^{-10a}$, $\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$ is the least positive $n\in\mathbb{N}$ with $-n \le \sigma_1(x)$ and $\sigma_2(x) \le n$ for all $x$ and $F, G$ contained in the ball around $\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)$ of radius $\mathrm{defaultD}(a)^n/4$, and $\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)$ is the point $o$ of the blueprint; let $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ denote its (finite) type of tiles and $\mathrm{Grid}(X)$ its (finite) type of dyadic cubes. Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be an $n$-forest (`Forest X n`), and let $u \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$; write $\mathfrak{T}(u) \subseteq \mathfrak{P}(X)$ for the set `t.𝔗 u` of the forest. Assume $u \in t$, i.e. $u$ belongs to the set of tops $t.\mathfrak{U}$ of the forest. Let $f, g : X \to \mathbb{C}$ both be bounded, compactly supported and measurable functions (`BoundedCompactSupport` with respect to $\mathrm{volume}$). For a set $\mathcal{C}$ of cubes and $h : X \to \mathbb{R}$, write $P_{\mathcal{C}} h(x) := \sum_{J \in \mathcal{C}} \mathbf{1}_J(x)\, ⨍_J h\,d\mathrm{volume}$ (`Forest.approxOnCube`). Let $\mathcal{J} := $ `Forest.𝓙`$(\mathfrak{T}(u))$, the set of maximal cubes in `Forest.𝓙₀`$(\mathfrak{T}(u))$, and $\mathcal{L} := $ `Forest.𝓛`$(\mathfrak{T}(u))$, the set of maximal cubes in `Forest.𝓛₀`$(\mathfrak{T}(u))$. Let $\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak{T}(u), f)(x) := \sum_{p \in \mathfrak{T}(u)} T_p f(x)$, where $T_p$ is the operator `carlesonOn p`. Then (Lemma 7.2.1) $$\Big\|\int_X \overline{g(x)}\, \mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak{T}(u), f)(x)\,d\mathrm{volume}(x)\Big\|_e \le C_{7.2.1}(a)\, \big\|P_{\mathcal{J}} |f|\big\|_{L^2(\mathrm{volume})}\, \big\|P_{\mathcal{L}} |g|\big\|_{L^2(\mathrm{volume})},$$ where $\|\cdot\|_e \in [0,\infty]$ is the extended norm, $|f|, |g| : X \to \mathbb{R}$ are $x \mapsto \|f(x)\|$ and $x \mapsto \|g(x)\|$, the $L^2$ norms are the $[0,\infty]$-valued `eLpNorm` with exponent $2$, and $C_{7.2.1}(a) \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ is the constant `Forest.C7_2_1 a` (value $2^{130a^3}$ in the blueprint).

TileStructure.Forest.boundary_operator_b.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$, and $F, G \subseteq X$. Assume given a `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` structure (the data common to chapters 2-7); through its `KernelProofData` component it makes $X$ a doubling metric measure space with constant $2^a$, and we write $\mathrm{volume}$ for the resulting measure on $X$. Let $Q := $ `ProofData.Q`, the simple function from $X$ to the type $\Theta(X)$ of functions supplied by this data. Assume also a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)`, where $\mathrm{defaultD}(a) = 2^{𝕔 a^2}$ (with $𝕔 \in \mathbb{N}$ the fixed blueprint constant, equal to $100$), $\mathrm{defaultκ}(a) = 2^{-10a}$, $\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$ is the least positive $n\in\mathbb{N}$ with $-n \le \sigma_1(x)$ and $\sigma_2(x) \le n$ for all $x$ and $F, G$ contained in the ball around $\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)$ of radius $\mathrm{defaultD}(a)^n/4$, and $\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)$ is the point $o$ of the blueprint; let $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ denote its (finite) type of tiles and $\mathrm{Grid}(X)$ its (finite) type of dyadic cubes. Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be an $n$-forest (`Forest X n`), and let $u \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$; write $\mathfrak{T}(u) \subseteq \mathfrak{P}(X)$ for the set `t.𝔗 u` of the forest. Let $f : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be a bounded, compactly supported and measurable function (`BoundedCompactSupport` with respect to $\mathrm{volume}$). Let $S_{1,u} f := $ `t.boundaryOperator u f` $: X \to [0,\infty]$, the operator of (7.1.4): $S_{1,u} f(x) = \sum_{I \in \mathrm{Grid}(X)} \mathbf{1}_I(x) \sum_{J \in \mathcal{J}'(I)} \frac{D^{(s(J) - s(I))/a}}{\mathrm{volume}(B(c(I), 16 D^{s(I)}))} \int_J \|f(y)\|\,d\mathrm{volume}(y)$, with $D = \mathrm{defaultD}(a)$, $c(I)$ and $s(I)$ the center and scale of the cube $I$, and $\mathcal{J}'(I)$ the set of cubes $J$ in `Forest.𝓙`$(\mathfrak{T}(u))$ with $J \subseteq B(c(I), 16 D^{s(I)})$ and $s(J) \le s(I)$. Then (Lemma 7.2.3) $$\|S_{1,u} f\|_{L^2(\mathrm{volume})} \le C_{7.2.3}(a)\, \|f\|_{L^2(\mathrm{volume})},$$ where the $L^2$ norms are the $[0,\infty]$-valued `eLpNorm` with exponent $2$ and $C_{7.2.3}(a) \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ is the constant `Forest.C7_2_3 a`.
